assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
There was a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The monitoring is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmia responsible for the transient cerebral ischemic attack
The monitoring is medically necessary to guide management of the sick sinus syndrome
Sick sinus syndrome is coded I49.5
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
